name: range-bands
summary: A spread per category from precomputed bounds: a light band from lo to hi, an optional darker inner band and a dot at the middle value, such as the 5th to 95th percentile, the middle half and the median. Takes an axis title.

roles.name: x
roles.doc: the category of each row, one row each

roles.name: lo
roles.doc: the low end of the outer band, such as the 5th percentile

roles.name: hi
roles.doc: the high end of the outer band, such as the 95th percentile

roles.name: mid
roles.doc: the middle value drawn as a dot, such as the median

roles.name: inner_lo
roles.doc: the low end of the darker inner band, such as the 25th percentile; needs inner_hi

roles.name: inner_hi
roles.doc: the high end of the inner band, such as the 75th percentile; needs inner_lo
